facts.value: The Department of Economics offers a joint European Triple-Bachelor in Economics and Business (EU Tribe) with partner universities Solvay Brussels School of Economics & Management and LUISS Rome.
Study in three significant European cities, at three renowned universities, and earn degrees from all three participating universities.
Students spend the first year in Frankfurt, followed by a year in Brussels and another year in Rome.
The studies in Brussels and Rome can be completed entirely in English.
Students have the opportunity to acquire or improve Italian and French language skills.
Interested students apply initially for the Bachelor's program in Economics at Goethe University. The application for the Triple-Bachelor program occurs in the first semester.
Participation is only possible for students starting their studies in the winter semester at the department.
The foreign study phase begins in the third semester.
In addition to good to very good academic performance, English language skills at B2 level are required.
The program is funded by scholarships under the Erasmus+ program for a maximum of one academic year (260 days).
Students participating at both partner universities are exempt from tuition fees.
